name: claudebox

provenance.pin: claude-code (latest vendor repo release, pinned at build time)
provenance.verification: dnf with gpgcheck=1 against Anthropic's published repo signing key

headless: Runs non-interactively with credentials injected at runtime from the persistent volume; the box harness drives it without a TTY.
self-update-disabled: The layer runs the dnf-managed binary read-only; the tool's self-update channel is disabled in its managed configuration so no self-installed binary can shadow the managed one.
policy-interface: The box harness constrains the tool's permission profile to the session's declared scope before launch.
